dsp GenFm1x6p1PluckFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 6.1 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6893

fm1x1p5Pad.source:
dsp GenFm1x1p5Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6659

dsp GenFm1x1p5PadFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6432

dsp GenFm1x1p5BassFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.6 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6315

fm1x8PluckFb.source:
dsp GenFm1x8PluckFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6903

dsp GenFm1x11Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 11.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6777

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6167

dsp GenFm3branch1x1Strike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7309

dsp GenFm3stack2x1Strike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6434

dsp GenFm3branch2x1Strike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6670

dsp GenFm3branch2x1Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6634

fm3stack1x3Organ.source:
dsp GenFm3stack1x3Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6166

dsp GenFm3branch1x3Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6852

dsp GenFm3stack3x7Swell where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 7.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6792

dsp GenFm3stack3x7Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 7.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6231

dsp GenFm3branch3x7Swell where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 7.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6522
